To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the temporal trajectory of structural supply chain alliance network configurations is influenced by prior structural configurations, absorptive capacity, as well as industry growth; (2) structural crossover effects are negative; (3) absorptive capacity has a positive moderation on structural reinforcement and (4) industry growth has a negative moderation on structural reinforcement.
We find that the evolution of supply chains is characterized by structural crossover effects between the key structural properties of alliance networks.

(a) structural network properties are not static but evolve over time; (b) prior network properties have a negative crossover effect on the evolution of network properties over time; (c) the evolution of supply chains is moderated by firm and industry level factors; (d) the evolution of network structure can be predicted with a separable exponential random graph model.

the evolution of supply chains, a topic that has been largely overlooked.
the structural anatomy and evolution of alliance networks in the supply chain context.
how structural properties of supply chains evolve and how they influence one another.
